sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    round(sum(transaction_value) / count(), 2) AS avg_transaction_value
FROM
(
    SELECT
        'Store' AS channel,
        SalesKey AS transaction_id,
        SalesAmount AS transaction_value
    FROM retail.FactSales

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Online' AS channel,
        SalesOrderNumber AS transaction_id,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS transaction_value
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
)
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel;
